title: Gerund, Infinitive, Conditional — Level 3 — Tap all the correct forms

items.prompt: Ketuk semua kata kerja yang diikuti gerund (verb-ing).
items.reteach: Enjoy, avoid, finish, mind (juga keep) + verb-ing. Want, decide, hope, refuse + to + verb 1.

items.prompt: Ketuk semua kata kerja yang diikuti to-infinitive (to + verb 1).
items.reteach: Want, decide, plan, refuse, hope + to + verb 1. Keep, enjoy, avoid + verb-ing.

items.prompt: Ketuk semua kalimat yang memakai gerund dengan tepat.

visual.text: He is fond of collecting stamps.

choices.say: He is fond of collecting stamps.

items.reteach: Avoid, finish, dan preposisi "of" + gerund. Hope, decide, refuse perlu to + verb 1.

items.prompt: Ketuk semua kalimat yang memakai to-infinitive dengan tepat.

visual.text: We plan to camp near Ranu Kumbolo.

choices.say: We plan to camp near Ranu Kumbolo.

visual.text: They hope to win the debate.

choices.say: They hope to win the debate.

visual.text: I enjoy to sing in the choir.

choices.say: I enjoy to sing in the choir.

items.reteach: Plan, refuse, hope + to-infinitive. Enjoy, keep, mind + gerund (singing, asking, waiting).

visual.text: If it rains, the match will be postponed.

choices.say: If it rains, the match will be postponed.

visual.text: If you press this button, the door will open.

choices.say: If you press this button, the door will open.

visual.text: If I were you, I would apologise.

choices.say: If I were you, I would apologise.

visual.text: If she had called, I would have answered.

choices.say: If she had called, I would have answered.

visual.text: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.

choices.say: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.

items.reteach: Type 1: If + simple present, will + verb 1 (kemungkinan nyata di masa depan).

visual.text: If I had wings, I would fly to Bali.

choices.say: If I had wings, I would fly to Bali.

visual.text: If he were taller, he would join the volleyball team.

choices.say: If he were taller, he would join the volleyball team.

visual.text: If he trains hard, he will join the team.

choices.say: If he trains hard, he will join the team.

visual.text: If we had left earlier, we would have arrived on time.

choices.say: If we had left earlier, we would have arrived on time.

visual.text: If you freeze water, it becomes ice.

choices.say: If you freeze water, it becomes ice.

visual.text: If it is sunny, we will go to the beach.

choices.say: If it is sunny, we will go to the beach.

items.reteach: Type 2: If + simple past (were/had), would + verb 1 untuk situasi tidak nyata sekarang.

visual.text: If they had booked early, they would have got cheap tickets.

choices.say: If they had booked early, they would have got cheap tickets.

visual.text: She would have won if she had practised more.

choices.say: She would have won if she had practised more.

visual.text: If they book early, they will get cheap tickets.

choices.say: If they book early, they will get cheap tickets.

visual.text: If they booked early, they would get cheap tickets.

choices.say: If they booked early, they would get cheap tickets.

visual.text: If you book early, you usually get cheap tickets.

choices.say: If you book early, you usually get cheap tickets.

items.reteach: Type 3: If + had + verb 3, would have + verb 3. Klausa if boleh di belakang.

items.prompt: Ketuk semua kalimat let/make + objek + bare infinitive yang tepat.

visual.text: Dad let me use his laptop.

choices.say: Dad let me use his laptop.

visual.text: The coach made us to run ten laps.

choices.say: The coach made us to run ten laps.

items.reteach: Setelah let/make + objek, pakai verb 1 tanpa "to", tanpa -ing, tanpa bentuk lampau.

items.prompt: Ketuk semua kalimat yang memakai gerund sebagai subjek.

visual.text: Swimming is good for your heart.

choices.say: Swimming is good for your heart.

visual.text: Eating too much sugar is unhealthy.

choices.say: Eating too much sugar is unhealthy.

visual.text: She is swimming in the river.

choices.say: She is swimming in the river.

visual.text: I want to eat less sugar.

choices.say: I want to eat less sugar.

items.reteach: Gerund sebagai subjek berada di awal kalimat dan diikuti kata kerja utama (is, protects).

items.prompt: Ketuk semua kalimat wish yang tepat.

visual.text: I wish I could speak Japanese.

choices.say: I wish I could speak Japanese.

visual.text: She wishes she had brought an umbrella yesterday.

choices.say: She wishes she had brought an umbrella yesterday.

visual.text: I wish it weren't so hot today.

choices.say: I wish it weren't so hot today.

visual.text: I wish I can speak Japanese.

choices.say: I wish I can speak Japanese.

visual.text: She wishes she brings an umbrella yesterday.

choices.say: She wishes she brings an umbrella yesterday.

visual.text: I wish it isn't so hot today.

choices.say: I wish it isn't so hot today.

items.reteach: Wish sekarang: past (could, weren't). Wish masa lalu: past perfect (had brought).

items.prompt: Ketuk semua frasa preposisi + gerund yang tepat.
items.reteach: Setelah preposisi (of, at, for, in) kata kerja selalu berbentuk -ing.

items.prompt: Ketuk semua kalimat conditional type 0 (fakta umum).

visual.text: If you heat ice, it melts.

choices.say: If you heat ice, it melts.

visual.text: If plants get no light, they die.

choices.say: If plants get no light, they die.

visual.text: If you heated ice, it would melt.

choices.say: If you heated ice, it would melt.

visual.text: If it snows in Malang, I will be surprised.

choices.say: If it snows in Malang, I will be surprised.

visual.text: If I had a garden, I would plant chillies.

choices.say: If I had a garden, I would plant chillies.

items.reteach: Type 0: If + simple present, simple present, untuk fakta yang selalu benar.

items.prompt: Ketuk semua kata yang tepat untuk "She ___ to join the science club."
items.reteach: Hanya kata kerja yang diikuti to-infinitive yang cocok: wants, decided, hopes, plans to join.
